SELECT fs.id, fs.scope, fs.target_id AS targetId, fs.user_id AS userId, fs.user_name AS userName, fs.tunnel_id AS tunnelId, fs.tunnel_name AS tunnelName, fs.user_tunnel_id AS userTunnelId, fs.trigger_type AS triggerType, fs.in_flow AS inFlow, fs.out_flow AS outFlow, fs.total_flow AS totalFlow, fs.flow_limit AS flowLimit, fs.forward_limit AS forwardLimit, fs.reset_day AS resetDay, fs.period_key AS periodKey, fs.settled_time AS settledTime, fs.created_time AS createdTime
ORDER BY fs.settled_time DESC, fs.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(1) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(fs.in_flow), 0) AS inFlow, COALESCE(SUM(fs.out_flow), 0) AS outFlow, COALESCE(SUM(fs.total_flow), 0) AS totalFlow
